# DM-Labs.io

> DM-Labs.io is a web design agency working remotely, building professional, mobile-first websites for businesses worldwide. Custom design, fast delivery, and direct support help businesses stand out and turn interest into enquiries.

## About

DM-Labs.io is a small, dedicated web design studio. We build custom, conversion-focused websites for businesses that want to stand out online. Our work combines distinctive design, fast delivery, clear paths to enquiry and personal technical care.

- Company: DM-Labs.io
- Location: Eleftheriou Chandrinou 5, Paphos 8045
- Phone: +35797472847
- Email: info@dm-labs.io
- Website: https://dm-labs.io
- Languages: English, Greek, Hebrew

## Services

- Custom website design and development, built around business goals
- Mobile-first, SEO-optimised websites
- Multilingual websites, scoped and quoted separately
- Website maintenance and content updates
- Local SEO setup and Google Business optimisation
- GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) for AI search visibility
- CMS self-editing interface, scoped and quoted separately
- E-commerce and online booking integration

## Packages

- Launch Website: €299: one page or two simple pages, 2 revision rounds
- Growth Website: €749: up to 4 pages, 3 revision rounds
- Pro Website: €1,499: up to 7 pages, 4 revision rounds
- Enterprise / Custom: pricing tailored to your scope
- Basic Care: €69/month or €750/year: up to 3 small content updates per month
- Complete Care: €129/month or €1,395/year: content updates when you need them
- SEO + GEO retainer: from €149/mo

The prices above are the EUR base prices. The website automatically shows ILS for country code IL, USD for US, CAD for CA, and EUR everywhere else or when the country is unavailable. Currency is independent of the page language. The regional prices are stable, rounded amounts:

| Package | EUR | USD | CAD | ILS |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |

| Growth Website (one-time build) | 749 | 875 | 1,225 | 2,600 |

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How long does it take to build a website?**
We agree a project schedule before work begins, based on the scope and the materials needed. Changes to scope, content or feedback may affect the schedule; revised dates are agreed together.

**Do you work with clients remotely?**
Yes. DM-Labs.io works with clients worldwide remotely via WhatsApp, email, and video call.

**Do you build websites in Greek?**
Yes. We work in English, Greek and Hebrew. The languages, translation and implementation requirements are agreed in each project scope.

**What is included in the price?**
All packages include custom design, responsive development and SEO foundations. Growth and Pro include a contact form. Page counts, revision rounds and additional features follow the selected package and agreed proposal. Hosting and care are required while DM-Labs.io hosts and manages the website. The build is a one-time cost. With monthly care, recurring billing begins in the month after official launch; annual care is billed as an annual amount. Prices exclude applicable taxes and separately agreed third-party costs.

**What is GEO and why does it matter?**
GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is the practice of structuring your website so that AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview can find and cite your business. It builds on sound SEO, useful content and accurate business information. Rankings, citations and inclusion in AI answers are decided by each platform and cannot be guaranteed.
